source_text:
This is a draft text intended for a class on operating systems. It
explains the main concepts of operating systems by studying an example
kernel, named xv6.  Xv6 is modeled on Dennis Ritchie's and
Ken Thompson's Unix Version 6 (v6)~<cite id="3"/>.  Xv6 loosely follows the structure
and style of v6, but is implemented in ANSI C~<cite id="2"/> for 
a multi-core RISC-V~<cite id="1"/>.
translation: Este es un texto preliminar destinado a una clase sobre sistemas operativos. Explica los conceptos principales de los sistemas operativos mediante el estudio de un kernel de ejemplo, llamado xv6. Xv6 está modelado sobre el Unix Version 6 (v6)~<cite id="3"/> de Dennis Ritchie y Ken Thompson. Xv6 sigue vagamente la estructura y el estilo de v6, pero está implementado en ANSI C~<cite id="2"/> para una arquitectura RISC-V~<cite id="1"/> multinúcleo.

source_text:
This text should be read along with the source code for xv6, an
approach inspired by John Lions' Commentary on UNIX 6th
Edition~<cite id="1"/>; the text has hyperlinks to the source code at
<macro id="2"/>. See
<macro id="1"/> for additional pointers to
on-line resources for v6 and xv6, including several lab assignments
using xv6.
translation: Este texto debe leerse junto con el código fuente de xv6, un enfoque inspirado en el Commentary on UNIX 6th Edition~<cite id="1"/> de John Lions; el texto contiene hipervínculos al código fuente en <macro id="2"/>. Consulte <macro id="1"/> para obtener referencias adicionales a recursos en línea para v6 y xv6, incluyendo varias tareas de laboratorio que utilizan xv6.

We have used this text in 6.828 and 6.1810, the operating system
classes at MIT.  We thank the faculty, teaching assistants, and
students of those classes who have all directly or indirectly
contributed to xv6.  In particular, we would like to thank Adam Belay,
Austin Clements, and Nickolai Zeldovich.  Finally, we would like to
thank people who emailed us bugs in the text or suggestions for
improvements: Abutalib Aghayev, Sebastian Boehm, brandb97, Anton
